# Unit Tests

Validate the smallest parts of the codebase independently, without external dependencies.

---

## Focus

- Business logic
- Utility functions
- Domain behaviour
- Individual transformations

---

## Characteristics

- Fast — should run in milliseconds
- Isolated — no database, no network, no filesystem
- Repeatable — same result every time
- Focused — one behaviour per test

---

## Guidance

- Mock external dependencies at boundaries
- Test behaviour, not implementation
- Keep tests small and named clearly
- Automate on every PR in CI

---

## Data-Specific Examples

- Python helper functions
- dbt schema tests for transformations, data types, column existence
- Individual transformation logic
